description: Registry of context-extension capability names (README section 4). Each name is the entry-point name in the tributary.context group and may be supplied by exactly one distribution. The item enum of channel-spec/v0 spec.pipeline.context must list exactly these names; contracts/validate.py checks that. tributary-runtime checks its loader against this file (two-way, like the error-code registry). Adding a name is additive and needs architect approval plus security-reviewer on the package.
distribution_match: PEP 503 normalised name (lowercase; runs of '-', '_', '.' become '-'), compared for equality
